registryAssessment: Tamil Nadu's official land-records procedure explicitly supports urban records by district, taluk, town, block, ward, survey number and subdivision number, and the official TamilNilam Geo-Info description identifies the Department of Survey and Settlement as the land-record map service operator. Kumbakonam's official municipal site also provides the local corporation/property-search context. These establish an official cadastral/land-record procedure and local municipal custodian context, but not an anonymously retrievable parcel-vector service.
blocker: No current anonymous safe native parcel identifier plus polygon was verified. Viewer timeouts and a non-cadastral TN-GIS landing page do not establish parcel absence or citywide coverage.
